mechanism_narrative: INSR+KIT forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) biases signaling toward MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathways through transphosphorylation of GRB2, SHC1, PIK3R1, GAB1, and IRS1 adaptors, while sterically excluding PLCG1 (Ca2+ branch) and STAT5 (JAK-STAT branch). The resulting transcriptome shift upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN — young-enriched P2 markers) and downregulates aged-enriched immediate early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory/stress markers (IL32, TXNIP), recapitulating the rejuvenating signature observed in ERBB2+FGFR wins. KIT is essentially absent from steady-state aged muscle atlas but is a well-established stem/progenitor marker induced during regeneration (PMID:22500403), making this candidate best suited for regenerative contexts rather than steady-state aged muscle.
